question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow its own interactive base-URL prompt and discovery step, or should remote LiteLLM users be routed to the existing Custom Provider path?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing, and the boundary between bundled provider setup and generic custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive `--custom-base-url` compatible.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update docs or prompts so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider.

options.title: Defer Dynamic Discovery
options.body: Leave the issue open until the broader credentialed provider catalog and discovery policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive `--custom-base-url` compatible.
